replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I see math as a puzzle to solve, not a chore. With my vocational diploma, I’ve learned practical math but not advanced theory. I enjoy its logic but prefer physics and art—math is a tool for understanding the world, not the focus of my passion.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: I don’t get anxious about math itself, but I do worry when it feels disconnected from real life. My parents’ different educational backgrounds (one with a PhD, the other only primary school) made me curious about how math applies practically, which keeps me calm.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Last year, I used AI tools to check my algebra homework. It helped me spot mistakes quickly but sometimes gave overly complex explanations. I preferred simple, step-by-step guidance over deep theory.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture most variance. You compute the covariance matrix, find its eigenvalues and eigenvectors, then project data onto those vectors. The math is linear algebra—don’t worry! It’s foundational for understanding patterns in data.
